structured.answer: The site says it doesn't calculate a long list of things yet. Close to me that means structured deposits, foreign-currency and dollar-linked deposits, savings policies, managers' insurance, corporate bonds and gold funds. I stopped after six screens without seeing a plain shekel deposit, so I'll ask my son or the bank before I rely on it.

stuck.where: First screen, cards ETC and LBMA Gold Price
stuck.why: English letters right at the top; it nearly felt like the page was not for me

stuck.where: Screen 5, two cards whose titles were above the screen
stuck.why: Could not tell what product they were (a manager buying at its discretion; a company supervising for bond holders)
Crossed-out dates, 'צומצם ב' and codes like MF-28, TX2-01, TXA-28 meant nothing to me
Tired; the same red 'לא מחושב' over and over; I stopped before the end of the list

used: Red banner 'החוקים והכללים לכל המוצרים כאן עוד בבדיקה. עד שייסגרו, האתר לא מחשב אותם.'
Card titles with the red 'לא מחושב' tag
'מה ידוע' lines on פיקדון במטבע חוץ, פיקדון מובנה, צמוד דולר, פוליסת חיסכון, ביטוח מנהלים
'שאלה פתוחה' lines on the deposit and policy cards
skimmed: ETC, LBMA, ארנק מט"ח דיגיטלי, הסדר חוב, חברת דירוג, מנוטרלת מט"ח, מסלולי האירוע cards
Securities-account guide cost table and glossary (read earlier)
skipped: Small blue source/law links and dates
not_found: An ordinary shekel bank deposit or bank savings plan (תוכנית חיסכון): I didn't see whether it's covered
Any plain sentence saying which products the site does fully compare
The end of the list (I stopped after screen 6)

findings.what: Every product carries a red 'לא מחושב' tag under a red banner. It's frightening, and none of the cards tells me what the site does calculate
Light text on a black background is hard to read even enlarged; the grey small text ('נקרא גם', 'כשייסגר', dates) is too pale
The page opens with English-letter products (ETC, LBMA Gold Price) instead of anything about deposits
Deposits close to mine (foreign-currency, structured, dollar-linked) and savings policies only appear on the sixth screen, where I was already tired
Internal codes and crossed-out dates (MF-28, TX2-01, TXA-28, 'נסגר ב-…', 'צומצם ב') mean nothing to a reader

This page says the site doesn't calculate 'עמלת חליפין'. The securities-account guide's cost table calls a similar fee 'המרת מטבע', names banks that charge it, and explains 'עמלת חליפין' in its glossary. Maybe not a real contradiction, but I can't tell what is covered
findings.where: 'עמלת חליפין' card (screen 5) vs guide's 'כמה זה עולה' table and glossary

findings.what: Some card titles were cut off at the top of the screen, so I couldn't tell which product the text belonged to
Small companies' names (laya.as-invest, Interactive Brokers) sit next to official sources; I wouldn't trust names I've never heard of
